title: A Bivariate $B$-Restricted Clique Polynomial: From Local Neighborhoods to Global Expansion
summary: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph and $B \subseteq V(G)$. We introduce the \emph{bivariate $B$-restricted clique polynomial} \[ C_B(G;x,y) = \sum_{\substack{K \subseteq V \\ K \text{ is a clique}}} x^{|K|} y^{|K \cap B|}, \] where the coefficient of $x^i y^j$ counts cliques of size $i$ with exactly $j$ vertices in $B$. This polynomial simultaneously captures combinatorial structure, local extremal properties, and spectral constraints associated with the subset $B$. \\ First, we develop vertex and edge deletion recurrences, generalizing classical clique polynomial results.
